name: arcdrip
description: ArcDrip: a shared USDC stream for collectives on Arc (one rate, N shares, live runway)

scripts.check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm contracts:fmt && pnpm sdk:check-abi && pnpm contracts:snapshot:check
scripts.contracts:abi: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && pnpm --filter @arcdrip/sdk generate:abi
scripts.e2e:dry-run: pnpm contracts:build && pnpm --filter '@arcdrip/sdk...' build && pnpm --filter @arcdrip/scripts e2e:dry-run
